==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Secret}} {{LU}}. He is only obtainable by Evolving 15 [[Vego]] and 15 [[Carrot]]. Or 5 Shiny Vegos and 5 Shiny Carrots to make a shiny variant of him. You also have to acquire the [[Evolution|Fusion Jacket]] for {{Gold|999}} from Green Alien in 2023 April Fools Event.

Veko was added as part of the 2023 April Fools Event.
